The native browser `select` element allows you to move to options by typing arbitrary characters when the select menu is open. The newly added `Select` component (which is greatly appreciated by the way!) does not support this functionality.

<!--- 
    If describing a bug, tell us what happens instead of the expected behavior.

steps.text:
Implemented type-to-focus navigation for Select’s menu list.

- Typed characters now match option labels, cycle repeated initials, and reset after 500 ms.
- Disabled/non-focusable items are skipped; unmatched input keeps focus stable.
- Added regression coverage in [MenuList.test.js](/testbed/packages/material-ui/test/integration/MenuList.test.js).
- Updated [MenuList.js](/testbed/packages/material-ui/src/MenuList/MenuList.js).

Validation: ESLint and `git diff --check` pass. The unit test runner cannot initialize under Node 22 because its legacy DOM setup attempts to overwrite read-only `global.navigator`.
